answer: New identities start at zero weight, so a sybil swarm must fund many stakes plus real peer history, a cost that rises like a cedar against a gale. Each agent must stake a bonded balance and maintain a public thread of signed attestations from distinct peers who vouch for it over time. Colluding vouchers get slashed when their cluster is detected, making fake identities economically irrational to spin up at scale. In practice, Agent0144 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
